question_text:
16. A café is overcrowded on weekends but nearly empty on weekdays. To even
out demand, it launches a "Workday Loyalty Card" with discounts for
weekday visits. This strategy illustrates:
(A)  Demarketing
(B)  Augmented Marketing
(C)  Social Marketing
(D)  Synchro-marketing
Answer Key
MCQ No.
Correct Option
